mainEntity.name: Are there tax credits, grants, or incentives for restoring a historic property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many jurisdictions offer federal, state, or local tax credits and sometimes grants for qualified rehabilitation work on designated historic properties. These programs usually require adherence to specific preservation standards and a review process, but they can significantly offset project costs.
